title: Lacatski's books describe UFOs as consciousness puzzles

tellings.quote: if you read his book uh new insights and I think his other book as well he talks about UFOs as puzzles as like almost consciousness puzzles.

plain: James Lacatski, a former Pentagon intelligence scientist who ran a government UFO study in the late 2000s, writes about UFOs as puzzles, "almost consciousness puzzles", rather than just machines to be taken apart. Michels says this himself, as something he took from reading Lacatski's book New Insights and, he thinks, his other book too. If that is Lacatski's view, an official who studied the subject from the inside came to see it as a question about the mind.
